messages:
Priya (design): on narrow screens (~360px) the Resources table causes horizontal scroll. Proposal: swap to a compact row list (full-width rows) or a swipe-up sheet. Thoughts?
Omar (frontend): prefer a sheet for action-heavy flows, but full-width rows are simpler and avoid modal focus traps.
Nora (product): we need filters visible. If we use a sheet, keep a filter pill in the toolbar that opens the sheet focused on filters.
Ken (pm): keyboard edge-cases: sheet inputs can get covered by keyboard on iOS; we should recalc heights on visualViewport changes.
a11y-bot: accessibility: when sheet opens move focus into it and trap focus; ensure 44px tappable targets; announce sheet as dialog.
Priya (design): copy: "Resources" ambiguous. Suggested label: "Workloads".
Omar (frontend): implementation plan: prototype compact rows + optional sheet; toolbar condenses to 48px at <=420px; truncation for IDs with inline "show" toggle. Test on iPhone SE / Pixel.
Nora (product): timeline: prototype by Tue, accessibility review Wed, mobile canary next sprint if green.
Priya (design): posting mocks in #design today; @Omar please add prototype link when ready. :thumbsup:
